articles.title_original: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city
articles.title_zh: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city
facts_zh:
Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city
- Published
There were raw emotional scenes as people evacuated from the devastated Russian-occupied city of Oleshky crossed from Belarus into the Ukrainian region of Chernihiv.
Families cried as they reunited with relatives they had not seen for years, with two sisters running and crying out as they embraced their father.
Some elderly residents were so weak they were carried on stretchers.

articles.title_original: Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training
articles.title_zh: Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training
facts_zh:
Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training
- Published
Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has put his cabinet ministers and other senior government officials through military training, saying armed forces discipline can help build stronger leaders and advance the country's development.
Photos shared by him on social media show him taking part in military exercises alongside ministers, deputy ministers and heads of government institutions at the Hurso military training centre.
The move is unusual in Ethiopia, where senior civilian government officials are rarely seen undergoing military training.

all_titles.en: Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training

articles.title_original: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
articles.title_zh: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
facts_zh:
US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
- Published
The United States has approved the sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine, a critically needed munition for defence against escalating Russian aerial attacks.
However, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has warned it could take "several years" for the deliveries to arrive.
The US State Department said the advanced PAC-3 interceptor missiles would cost $2.1bn (£1.6bn) and would be "funded entirely" by Kyiv's allies in Europe and Canada.

all_titles.en: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine

facts_zh:
Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
- Published
The breaking news from Spain this week was shocking but also shockingly familiar: another collision on the high-speed rail line south from Madrid, with reports of dozens killed.
It is just nine months since two trains crashed near Cordoba, killing 46 people.
Now 69 bodies have been recovered here in central Spain, from wreckage strewn over the tracks and down an embankment.
